name: rastertrace-webapp
description: rastertrace browser-based raster to SVG converter

scripts.lint: oxlint js tests scripts e2e playwright.config.mjs --import-plugin --jsdoc-plugin --deny-warnings
scripts.build:wasm: cd wasm && RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/registry=/registry" wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir ../pkg --release && rm -f ../pkg/.gitignore
